P.name: Call of the Freljord
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Nunu''' and '''Willump''' deal damage against an enemy {{tip|champion}}, large {{tip|monster}} or {{tip|turrets|structure}}, they and a nearby allied champion gain ''Call of the Freljord'' for 4 seconds, prioritizing the ally with {{sti|{{as|'''highest''' attack speed}}}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Call of the Freljord:}} Gain {{sti|{{as|20% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. '''Willump's''' {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} additionally deal {{as|30% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to secondary targets in a cone in front of him.
P.description3: '''Nunu''' and '''Willump''' cannot trigger ''Call of the Freljord'' from the same enemy again for a time. Successive triggers of ''Call of the Freljord'' while it is active will extend the duration by 4 seconds.

Q.name: Consume
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Willump''' takes a bite out of the target enemy, dealing damage and {{tip|healing}} himself. The heal is increased by {{ap|(1.5-1)*100}}% while he is {{as|below 50% '''maximum''' health}}.
Q.description2: Against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}, he deals {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}. Additionally, if ''Consume'' would kill the target minion or small or medium monster, '''Willump''' devours the target, {{tip|stun|stunning}} and {{tip|airborne|pulling}} them towards him over the cast time.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Non-Champion True Damage|{{ap|400 to 1200}}}}
{{st|Base Non-Champion Heal|{{ap|65 to 185}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}} {{as|(+ 10% '''bonus''' health)}}|Empowered Non-Champion Heal|{{ap|65*1.5 to 185*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90*1.5}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*1.5}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
Q.description3: Against {{tip|champions}}, he deals {{as|magic damage}} and the heal is reduced to {{ap|0.6*100}}%.
Q.leveling3:
{{st|Champion Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 220}} {{as|(+ 65% AP)}} {{as|(+ 5% '''bonus''' health)}}}}
{{st|Base Champion Heal|{{ap|65*0.6 to 185*0.6}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90*0.6}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*0.6}}% '''bonus''' health)}}|Empowered Champion Heal|{{ap|65*0.6*1.5 to 185*0.6*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|90*0.6*1.5}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*0.6*1.5}}% '''bonus''' health)}}}}

W.name: Biggest Snowball Ever!
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Willump''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} himself from all {{tip|slow|slows}} and {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 10 seconds, becoming {{tip|ghosted}} and {{tip|slow-immune}} and creating a rolling {{ccib|Biggest Snowball Ever! Minimap.png||snowball}}. '''Willump''' automatically navigates his movement in the direction of the cursor and can steer the snowball at an increasing speed over time, which resets upon changing direction. The duo have their {{sti|{{as|movement speed}}}} reduced by {{as|50%|ms}} for the first 1 second, but after a delay they start gaining {{tt|{{as|14 movement speed}}|Estimated}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, {{tt|up to a cap|See notes.}}.
W.description2: The snowball increases in size and power linearly over the duration. Its size changes from ''small'' to ''medium'' after {{fd|2.5}} seconds, then to ''large'' after 5 seconds into the charge. ''Biggest Snowball Ever!'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically after the channel or if {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
W.description3: The snowball explodes upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|pet|large pet}}, medium or large {{tip|monster}}, or terrain, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, increased by {{pp|type=charge time|key=%|0;0 to 400 for 5|0 to 5|formula=Increases linearly after 1 second into the duration.}}, {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for {{pp|type=charge time|0.5;0.5 to 0.75 for 5|0 to 5|formula=Increases linearly after 1 second into the duration.}} seconds and subsequently {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{pp|type=charge time|0;0;0;0 to 0.75 for 9|0;1;2;2.33 to 5|formula=Increases linearly after 2.33 seconds into the duration.}} seconds. If the snowball exploded while it was being steered, '''Willump''' becomes {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{tt|{{rutngt|0.1}}|estimated; 0.1 seconds, but rounded up to the next game tick}}.
W.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|36 to 72}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|36*5 to 72*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*5}}% AP)}}}}
W.description4: The snowball rolls over enemy {{tip|minion|minions}} and small monsters hit, dealing {{fd|33.3}}% of the damage as {{as|magic damage}}.
W.leveling4: {{st|Minimum Minion/Monster Roll Damage|{{ap|36*0.333 to 72*0.333}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.333}}% AP)}}|Maximum Minion/Monster Roll Damage|{{ap|36*0.333*5 to 72*0.333*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*0.333*5}}% AP)}}}}
W.description5: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Willump''' releases the snowball, sending it rolling forward up to a maximum distance during which it will not grow any larger and will explode upon hitting any enemy.

E.name: Snowball Barrage
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nunu''' throws a volley of 3 snowballs in the target direction over {{fd|0.4}} seconds that each shatter upon hitting an enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in a cone.
E.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage Per Hit|{{ap|15 to 45}} {{as|(+ 12% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|15*3 to 45*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12*3}}% AP)}}}}
E.description2: Enemies hit 3 times are {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 1 second. Enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} hit once are marked ''Snowbound'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits. ''Snowball Barrage'' can be recast twice within 3 seconds at no additional cost and with a {{tt|1-second cooldown|Affected by ability haste}} between casts.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Nunu''' hurls another volley of snowballs, mimicking the first cast's effects. An enemy may be {{tip|slow|slowed}} only once for being hit by snowballs.
E.description4: After 3 seconds from the first cast, ''Snowbound'' enemies near '''Willump''' take {{as|magic damage}} and are {{tip|root|rooted}} for {{pp|0.5 + (1.5-0.5)/17*(x-1) for 20}} seconds.

R.name: Absolute Zero
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nunu''' and '''Willump''' {{tip|channel}} a blizzard for up to 3 seconds, granting themselves a {{tip|shield}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} nearby enemies by {{pp|type=channel time|key=%|0;50 to 95 for 11;95|0 to 3|formula=Increases by 4.5% every 0.25 seconds. ''Starts at 0.25 seconds and finishes at 2.75 seconds''}}.
R.description2: ''Absolute Zero'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically when the channel ends by any means.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Nunu''' and '''Willump''' cause the blizzard to explode, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, modified to {{pp|key=%|type=channel time|changedisplay=true|0 to 100|0 to 3 by 1|formula=Increases the damage by 1% of its maximum damage value every 0.03 seconds.}}. Affected enemies will remain {{tip|slow|slowed}} for {{pp|type=channel time|0 to 3 for 13|0 to 3}} seconds and any of the duo's remaining shield will decay over 3 seconds.
